activities.name: produce
activities.run:
set -eu
printf route=+hpc+-+cloud+
sequence=1
 > payload.txt
sha256sum payload.txt > payload.sha256
test -s payload.txt

activities.name: consume
activities.run:
set -eu
test -s payload.txt
sha256sum -c payload.sha256
grep -qx route=+hpc+-+cloud+ payload.txt
printf consumed=+cloud+
 > receipt.txt
